name: Transfer Press – The Ultimate WordPress Plugin Zip Downloader, Activator
author: Ruman Ahmed

sections.description:
Transfer Press is a WordPress plugin for seamlessly downloading, exporting, and importing plugins between WordPress installations. Whether you’re a developer moving plugins from staging to production, an agency deploying consistent plugin stacks across client sites, or a site owner creating plugin backups, Transfer Press streamlines your plugin migration workflow.

Forget dealing with FTP, ZIP tools, or file managers. Plugin migration and backup become a simple process directly from your WordPress dashboard.

With Transfer Press, you can:

  • Download any installed plugin as a clean ZIP archive with one click.
  • Import plugin ZIP files and optionally activate them instantly.
  • Speed up staging-to-production migrations and site cloning.
  • Create quick plugin backups before updates or handovers.

Ideal for:

  • WordPress developers
  • Agencies managing multiple client sites
  • Freelancers performing regular migrations
  • Site owners creating plugin backups

Features

  • Download installed plugins as ZIP archives
  • Import plugin ZIP files and install with one click
  • Optional auto-activation after import
  • Works on both single-site and multisite WordPress setups
  • Smart interface with progress bars and real-time notifications
  • Secure import validation to prevent malformed uploads
  • Ideal for plugin migrations, cloning, and backups
  • No FTP or file manager required

Usage

  1. Open Transfer Press from your WordPress dashboard.
  2. To export, choose a plugin, click Export, and download the generated ZIP file.
  3. To import, upload a plugin ZIP file and click Import. The plugin will be installed and can be activated automatically.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/transfer-press or install it via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Transfer Press > Export to export plugins.
  4. Use Transfer Press > Import to upload and install plugin ZIP files.
sections.faq:
Can I migrate plugins between two WordPress sites?

Yes. Export the plugin as a ZIP file from one site and import it into another using Transfer Press.

Will the plugin be activated automatically after importing?

Yes. You can choose to activate the plugin automatically after it has been imported.

Does Transfer Press support WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Transfer Press works with both single-site and multisite WordPress installations.

Can I transfer premium plugins?

Yes. Premium plugins can be exported and imported as ZIP files, provided you comply with the plugin author’s licensing terms.

Is FTP required?

No. Everything is handled directly through the WordPress dashboard.
